questions.question: If one angle of a triangle is equal to the sum of the other two angles, then the triangle is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

In any **triangle**, the sum of all three interior angles is always 180°.

If one angle is equal to the **sum of the other two**, it means that angle represents exactly **half** of the total sum of the angles.

Calculation: 180° ÷ 2 = 90°.

Since one angle of the triangle is **90°**, it must be a **right-angle triangle**.

**∴ The correct answer is a right-angle triangle.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Let the three angles of the triangle be ∠A, ∠B, and ∠C.

According to the problem: ∠A = ∠B + ∠C

**Formula Used:**

**Angle Sum Property** of a triangle: ∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180°

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc0192e46b3bd0c0d8910e170368c7d459c2b4f8bc2c452d20dfaedf5eb56ead.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ ∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180°

⇒ ∠A + (∠B + ∠C) = 180°

⇒ Substitute ∠B + ∠C = ∠A into the equation:

⇒ ∠A + ∠A = 180°

⇒ 2 × ∠A = 180°

⇒ ∠A = 180° ÷ 2

⇒ ∠A = 90°

Since one of the angles is **90°**, the triangle is a **right-angle triangle**.

**∴ The correct answer is a right-angle triangle.**

**__Additional Information__**

Angle Sum Property

The sum of all interior angles of any triangle is always 180°.

Classification by Angles

A triangle is **acute** if all angles 90°.

Right-Angle Triangle Properties

In a right triangle, the square of the **hypotenuse** (side opposite 90°) is equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides (Pythagoras Theorem).</p

questions.question: What is the value of (a - b)³ - a³ + b³?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Expand the expression using the **algebraic identity**: **(a − b)³ = a³ − b³ − 3ab(a − b)**.

Substitute this expansion into the given expression: **[a³ − b³ − 3ab(a − b)] − a³ + b³**.

Cancel the **identical terms** with opposite signs: **a³ − a³ = 0** and **−b³ + b³ = 0**.

The remaining term is **−3ab(a − b)**.

**∴ The correct answer is -3ab(a - b).**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression = (a − b)³ − a³ + b³

**Formula Used:**

The standard **cubic expansion** identity is: (x − y)³ = x³ − 3x²y + 3xy² − y³

This can also be written as: (x − y)³ = x³ − y³ − 3xy(x − y)

**Calculations:**

⇒ (a − b)³ − a³ + b³

⇒ [a³ − 3a²b + 3ab² − b³] − a³ + b³

⇒ a³ − a³ − b³ + b³ − 3a²b + 3ab²

⇒ 0 + 0 − 3a²b + 3ab²

⇒ −3ab(a − b)

**∴ The correct answer is -3ab(a - b).**

**__Additional Information__**

Cubical Identity (Sum)

(a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b) or a³ + 3a²b + 3ab² + b³.

Difference of Cubes

a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + ab + b²).

Sum of Cubes

a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² − ab + b²).</p

questions.question: Three numbers are in the ratio 13 ∶ 15 ∶ 17. If the difference between thrice the third number and the sum of first and second number is 529, then find the difference between the first and third number.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of the three numbers = 13 : 15: 17 

3times third number - (first +second) number = 529

**Calculation:**

Ratio of the three numbers = 13:15 :17 

Let the numbers be 13x , 15x and 17x 

According to the given question

3 times third number - ( first + second) number=529

⇒ 3 × 17x - (13x + 15x ) = 529 

⇒ 51x - 28x = 529

⇒ 23x = 529 

⇒ x = 23 

So, the numbers are 

First number = 13x = 13× 23 = 299

Second number = 15x = 15 × 23 = 345

Third number = 17x = 17 × 23 = 391

So, difference between first and third number 

⇒ 391 - 299 = 92

**Hence, the required difference is 92 .**

questions.question: A train of length 360 meters crosses an electric pole in 30 seconds and crosses another train of the same length traveling in the opposite direction in 15 seconds. What is the speed of the second train?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Speed** of the first train (S₁) = 360 ÷ 30 = 12 m/s.

**Relative Speed** in **opposite direction** = (360 + 360) ÷ 15 = 720 ÷ 15 = 48 m/s.

Speed of the **second train** (S₂) = Relative Speed − S₁ = 48 − 12 = 36 m/s.

**∴ The correct answer is 36 m/s.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Length** of Train 1 (L₁) = 360 m

**Time** to cross **electric pole** = 30 sec

**Length** of Train 2 (L₂) = 360 m

**Time** to cross each other in **opposite direction** = 15 sec

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/218b1cfa403d7c31ee3d4c440799805d2711881a1bd90e77bdb2e158a6d1ae39.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Relative Speed (Opposite) = S₁ + S₂

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed of Train 1 (S₁) = L₁ ÷ Time to cross pole

⇒ S₁ = 360 ÷ 30 = 12 m/s

⇒ Total Distance while crossing each other = L₁ + L₂ = 360 + 360 = 720 m

⇒ Relative Speed = Total Distance ÷ Time to cross each other

⇒ S₁ + S₂ = 720 ÷ 15

⇒ 12 + S₂ = 48

⇒ S₂ = 48 − 12 = 36 m/s

**∴ The correct answer is 36 m/s.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Concepts

When moving in the **opposite direction**, Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂. When moving in the **same direction**, Relative Speed = |S₁ − S₂|.

Crossing Distance

The distance covered to cross a **stationary point** (pole, person) is the **train length**. To cross another **object with length** (train, bridge), the distance is (L₁ + L₂).

Unit Conversion

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.</p

questions.question: The ratio of the length and breadth of the rectangle is 24 : 7. If the diagonal length of the rectangle is 50 cm, then find the area of the rectangle. (in cm²)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of sides = 24 : 7

Using Pythagorean triplet (7, 24, 25), the ratio of the diagonal is 25 units.

Given, 25 units = 50 cm ⇒ 1 unit = 2 cm.

Length = 24 × 2 = 48 cm and Breadth = 7 × 2 = 14 cm.

Area = Length × Breadth = 48 × 14 = 672 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 672 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of length (L) and breadth (B) = 24 : 7

Diagonal (d) = 50 cm

**Formula Used:**

Diagonal of rectangle = √(L² + B²)

Area of rectangle = L × B

 
 
• 
 Length = 24x
 Breadth = 7x
 Diagonal = 50 cm
 Rectangle Properties

Let Length = 24x and Breadth = 7x

⇒ d² = L² + B²

⇒ 50² = (24x)² + (7x)²

⇒ 2500 = 576x² + 49x²

⇒ 2500 = 625x²

⇒ x² = 2500 ÷ 625

⇒ x² = 4

⇒ x = 2

⇒ Length = 24 × 2 = 48 cm

⇒ Breadth = 7 × 2 = 14 cm

⇒ Area = 48 × 14

⇒ Area = 672 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 672 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Triplet

A set of three positive integers a, b, and c such that a² + b² = c². Common triplets include (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), (7, 24, 25), and (8, 15, 17).

Perimeter of Rectangle

The total distance around the rectangle, calculated as P = 2 × (Length + Breadth).

Diagonal and Area Relation

Area can also be expressed if the sum of sides (S) and diagonal (d) are known: Area = (S² − d²) ÷ 2.</p

questions.question: What is the value of x in the number 3426x if the number is divisible by 6 but NOT divisible by 5?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a number to be **divisible by 6**, it must be **even** and the sum of its digits must be divisible by 3.

Sum of digits of 3426x = 3 + 4 + 2 + 6 + x = 15 + x. For this to be a multiple of 3, x can be 0, 3, 6, or 9.

Since the number must be **even**, x must be 0 or 6. Since it is **NOT divisible by 5**, x cannot be 0.

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** The number is **3426x**. It is divisible by 6 but **NOT divisible by 5**.

**Formula Used:** Divisibility rules for 2, 3, 5, and 6.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e74166075976ba34b4d084ef776d9277b9ae3276f02f464a398564006148768a.png] 

⇒ For **divisibility by 2**, the last digit x must be even: {0, 2, 4, 6, 8}.

⇒ For **divisibility by 3**, sum of digits = 3 + 4 + 2 + 6 + x = 15 + x. This sum must be divisible by 3.

⇒ Possible values for x from the sum condition: {0, 3, 6, 9}.

⇒ Combining both (**divisibility by 6**), x must be in the intersection: {0, 6}.

⇒ For **divisibility by 5**, the last digit must be 0 or 5. Since 3426x is **NOT divisible by 5**, x ≠ 0.

⇒ From the remaining possible values {0, 6}, we exclude 0, leaving **x = 6**.

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility by 3

A number is divisible by 3 if the **sum of all its digits** is a multiple of 3.

Divisibility by 6

A number is divisible by 6 if it satisfies the divisibility rules for both **2** (ends in 0, 2, 4, 6, 8) and **3** simultaneously.

Divisibility by 5

A number is divisible by 5 if its **unit digit** is either **0 or 5**.

Divisibility by 4

A number is divisible by 4 if the **last two digits** of the number are divisible by 4 or are 00.</p

questions.question: A started a business with an initial capital of Rs 40,000. Later, A was joined by B after 9 months. At the end of the year, the profit of B was 3over8 times of A. Find the amount invested by B.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Profit Ratio (A : B) = 8 : 3

Time Ratio (A : B) = 12 : 3 = 4 : 1

Investment Ratio = (Profit ÷ Time) → (8 ÷ 4) : (3 ÷ 1) = 2 : 3

If 2 units = Rs 40,000, then 1 unit = Rs 20,000

B investment = 3 units = 3 × 20,000 = Rs 60,000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs 60,000.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Investment of A (CA) = Rs 40,000

Time of A (TA) = 12 months

Time of B (TB) = 12 − 9 = 3 months

Profit of B (PB) = 3/8 × Profit of A (PA)

**Formula:**

Profit Ratio = (CA × TA) : (CB × TB)

•

**Calculations:**

⇒ PA : PB = 8 : 3

⇒ (CA × TA) / (CB × TB) = 8 / 3

⇒ (40,000 × 12) / (CB × 3) = 8 / 3

⇒ 480,000 / (3 × CB) = 8 / 3

⇒ 160,000 / CB = 8 / 3

⇒ 8 × CB = 160,000 × 3

⇒ 8 × CB = 480,000

⇒ CB = 480,000 / 8

⇒ CB = 60,000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs 60,000.**

**__Additional Information__**

Basic Partnership Rule

Profit is distributed in the ratio of the product of capital and the time for which it was invested: P₁ : P₂ = C₁T₁ : C₂T₂.

Capital with Variable Time

If a partner changes their investment after some months, the total effective capital is the sum of (Investment × Duration) for each period.

Active vs. Sleeping Partner

An active partner manages the business and may receive a salary or extra profit percentage, while a sleeping partner only contributes capital.</p

questions.question: If 3 tan θ = 2, find the value of (2 sintheta-costheta)/(2 costheta-sintheta).
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Given **3 tan θ = 2**, we have **tan θ = 2/3**, which means **sin θ / cos θ = 2/3**.

For a **homogeneous expression** in sin θ and cos θ, we can directly substitute **sin θ = 2** and **cos θ = 3**.

Expression = (2 sin θ − cos θ) ÷ (2 cos θ − sin θ)

Substituting values: (2 × 2 − 3) ÷ (2 × 3 − 2) = (4 − 3) ÷ (6 − 2) = **1/4**.

**∴ The correct answer is 1/4.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** 3 tan θ = 2 ⇒ **tan θ = 2/3**

**Formula Used:** tan θ = sin θ ÷ cos θ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5dce9b1c8da4f27762fb740df37044bafb17a3638896ff3fcf8ab3d4bdde965c.png] 

⇒ Expression = (2 sin θ − cos θ) ÷ (2 cos θ − sin θ)

⇒ Divide the numerator and denominator by **cos θ**:

⇒ [(2 sin θ / cos θ) − (cos θ / cos θ)] ÷ [(2 cos θ / cos θ) − (sin θ / cos θ)]

⇒ (2 tan θ − 1) ÷ (2 − tan θ)

⇒ Now, substitute **tan θ = 2/3** into the simplified expression:

⇒ [2 × (2/3) − 1] ÷ [2 − (2/3)]

⇒ (4/3 − 1) ÷ (6/3 − 2/3)

⇒ (1/3) ÷ (4/3) = 1/4

**∴ The correct answer is 1/4.**

**__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Ratios

For any angle θ, **tan θ = sin θ / cos θ** and **cot θ = cos θ / sin θ = 1 / tan θ**.

Homogeneous Expressions

When every term in a fraction involves **sin θ** or **cos θ** to the same power, dividing by **cos θ** converts the entire expression into a function of **tan θ**.

Pythagorean Relation

In a right triangle, **sin θ = p/h**, **cos θ = b/h**, and **tan θ = p/b**. The relationship is defined by **h² = p² + b²**.</p

questions.question: Three partners shared the profit in a business in the proportion of 9 ∶ 8 ∶ 11. They invested their capitals for 4 months, 6 months and 18 months, respectively. What was the ratio of their capitals?
questions.solution:
Given:

Three partners shared the profit in a business in the proportion of 9 ∶ 8 ∶ 11. They invested their capital for 4 months, 6 months, and 18 months, respectively. 

Concept used:

Profit is shared according to the capital invested.

Total investment = Invested Capital × Time period of the investment

Calculation:

Let the invested capital by them be P, Q, and R respectively.

According to the concept,

(P × 4) : (Q × 6) : (R × 18) = 9 : 8 : 11

⇒ 4P : 6Q : 18R = 9 : 8 : 11

Equating individual terms we get,

4P = 9

⇒ P = 9/4

Similarly, Q = 8/6 & R = 11/18

Now, we get,

P : Q : R = 9/4 : 8/6 : 11/18

⇒ P : Q : R = 9/4 × 36 : 8/6 × 36 : 11/18 × 36 

⇒ P : Q : R = 81 : 48 : 22

**∴ The ratio of their capitals is 81 : 48 : 22.**

questions.question: If (x - 3)² + (y - 4)² + (z + 7)² = 0, then find the value of x³ + y³ + z³.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(x - 3)2 + (y - 4)2 + (z + 7)2 = 0

**Concept used:**

(1.) a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc = (a + b + c)(x² + y² + z² - xy - yz - zx)

When a + b + c = 0, then a3 + b3 + c3 = 3abc

(2.) When (x - a)² + (y - b)² + (z - c)² = 0, then x = a, y = b and z = c

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

⇒ (x - 3)2 + (y - 4)2 + (z + 7)2 = 0

Therefore, 

⇒ x = 3, y = 4, z = -7

Since x + y + z = 3 + 4 - 7 = 0,

Therefore, 

⇒ ? = x³ + y³ + z³

⇒ ? = 33 + 43 + (-7)3

⇒ ? = 27 + 64 - 343

⇒ ? = 91 - 343

⇒ ? = -252

**Therefore, '-252' is the required answer.**

questions.question: In a rectangle PQRS, if m∠QPR = 26°, then m∠SQR = ________.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a **rectangle**, the angle between a diagonal and a side is **complementary** to the angle between the other diagonal and the adjacent side.

∠SQR = 90° − ∠QPR

∠SQR = 90° − 26° = 64°

**∴ The correct answer is 64°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** ∠QPR = 26° in **rectangle PQRS**.

**Formula Used:** Diagonals of a rectangle are equal and bisect each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85fbd6ec0ce2d674ce03e31c1e843a7119b771d75643ca504512aefd4c8183ea.png] 

⇒ In **rectangle PQRS**, diagonals **PR** and **QS** intersect at **O**.

⇒ Since diagonals are equal and bisect each other, **OP = OQ**.

⇒ In **ΔPOQ**, **∠PQO = ∠QPR = 26°** (Angles opposite to equal sides).

⇒ **∠PQR = 90°** (Interior angle of a rectangle).

⇒ **∠SQR = ∠PQR − ∠PQO**

⇒ **∠SQR = 90° − 26° = 64°**.

**∴ The correct answer is 64°.**<

questions.question: A person travels equal distances at speeds of 5 km/h, 8 km/h and 10 km/h and takes a total time of 61 min 12 sec. The total distance travelled by the person is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Average speed for 3 equal distances at speeds a, b, c = 3abc ÷ (ab + bc + ca)

Average speed = (3 × 5 × 8 × 10) ÷ (40 + 80 + 50) = 1200 ÷ 170 = 120/17 km/h.

Total Time = 61 min 12 sec = 306/5 mins = 51/50 hours.

Total Distance = Average Speed × Total Time = (120/17) × (51/50) = 7.2 km.

**∴ The correct answer is 7.2 km.**

Average Speed for Equal Distances

Average Speed for Equal Time

questions.question: A train leaves Chennai at 5 p.m., and reaches Coimbatore at 12 a.m. Another train leaves Coimbatore at 4 p.m. and reaches Chennai at 1 a.m. At what time will the trains cross each other, assuming they travel in the same route and at a constant speed?
questions.solution:
Given:

Train 1 leaves Chennai station at 5 p.m. and reaches Coimbatore at 12 a.m.

Train 2 leaves Coimbatore station at 4 p.m and reaches Chennai at 1 a.m

Formula used:

Speed = Distance/time

If two objects move with the speeds u & v in opposite directions, then

Relative speed = u + v

Calculation:

Train 1 travel time = 7 hours

Train 2 travel time = 9 hours

We know, speed = Distance/time

Let the distance between Chennai & Coimbatore is 63 Km (LCM of 7 & 9)

Speed of 1st train = 63/7 = 9 km/h

⇒ Speed of 2nd train = 63/9 = 7 km/h

Relative speed = Train 1 speed + Train 2 speed

⇒ Relative speed = 9 + 7 = 16 km/h

Train 2 travels for 1 hours before train 1 starts

Remaining distance = 63 - 7/1 = 56 km

Train is taken to cross each other

⇒ Time = 56/16 = 3.5 hours

Total time taken = 3.5 + 1 = 4.5 hrs

So, they cross each other = 4 pm + 4.5 hrs = 8 : 30 pm

∴ They cross each other a**t ****8 : 30 pm.**

questions.question: The time taken by a boat to go 34 km upstream is 25% more than the time it takes to go 40 km downstream. If the speed of the stream is 4 km/h, then what is the speed (in km/h) of the boat in still water?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Time ratio (Upstream : Downstream) = 125% : 100% = 5 : 4

Time = Distance ÷ Speed ⇒ [34 ÷ (u − 4)] ÷ [40 ÷ (u + 4)] = 5 ÷ 4

⇒ (u + 4) ÷ (u − 4) = (5 × 40) ÷ (4 × 34) = 200 ÷ 136 = 25 ÷ 17

Applying Componendo & Dividendo: u ÷ 4 = (25 + 17) ÷ (25 − 17) = 42 ÷ 8

⇒ u = 42 × 4 ÷ 8 = 21

**∴ The correct answer is 21 km/h.**

⇒ 34 ÷ (u − 4) = [40 ÷ (u + 4)] × (5 ÷ 4)

⇒ 34 ÷ (u − 4) = 50 ÷ (u + 4)

⇒ 34(u + 4) = 50(u − 4)

⇒ 34u + 136 = 50u − 200

⇒ 50u − 34u = 136 + 200

⇒ 16u = 336

Speed in Still Water

If the downstream speed is D and upstream speed is U, the speed of the boat in still water = (D + U) ÷ 2.

Speed of the Stream

Relative Speed Concept in Rivers

When a boat moves downstream, the relative speed is the sum of the boat's speed and the stream's speed. Upstream, it is their difference as the stream opposes the motion.

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by both, 7 and 11?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a number to be divisible by both **7** and **11**, it must be divisible by their **LCM**, which is **77**.

Check **1771 ÷ 77**: 77 × 2 = 154; 177 − 154 = 23; Bring down 1 → 231. 77 × 3 = 231.

Since 1771 is perfectly divisible by 77, it is the answer.

**∴ The correct answer is 1771.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given Numbers:** 1771, 3014, 2684, 2534

**Divisibility Rules:**

**Rule for 11:** (Sum of digits at odd places) − (Sum of digits at even places) should be 0 or a multiple of 11.

**Rule for 7:** (Units digit × 2) subtracted from the remaining number should be 0 or a multiple of 7.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9eb73aa79f88b4d9aac5d18f9553164a40acc4ac3571d9c8d9d7ce988ccd76c.png] 

Checking each option for **11** first:

⇒ (1) **1771**: (1+7) − (7+1) = 8 − 8 = 0 (Divisible by 11)

⇒ (2) **3014**: (3+1) − (0+4) = 4 − 4 = 0 (Divisible by 11)

⇒ (3) **2684**: (2+8) − (6+4) = 10 − 10 = 0 (Divisible by 11)

⇒ (4) **2534**: (2+3) − (5+4) = 5 − 9 = −4 (Not Divisible by 11)

Now check (1), (2), and (3) for **7**:

⇒ (1) **1771**: 177 − (1 × 2) = 175; 17 − (5 × 2) = 7 (Divisible by 7)

⇒ (2) **3014**: 301 − (4 × 2) = 293; 29 − (3 × 2) = 23 (Not Divisible by 7)

⇒ (3) **2684**: 268 − (4 × 2) = 260; 26 − (0 × 2) = 26 (Not Divisible by 7)

**∴ The correct answer is 1771.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility by 77

If a number is divisible by **coprime factors** a and b, it is also divisible by their product (a × b). Since 7 and 11 are prime, we check for 77.

Rule of 7, 11, 13

For larger numbers, divide the digits into groups of three from right to left and find the alternating sum; if the result is divisible by 7, 11, or 13, the number is too.

Co-prime Numbers

Numbers whose only common factor is 1. All prime numbers are co-prime to each other.</p

questions.question: A cube of edge 4 cm is cut into cubes each of edge of 2 cm. The ratio of the total surface area of one of the small cubes to that of the large cube is equal to:

questions.question: For the value of 'k', is added to each of 13, 23, 4 and 5, the numbers obtained in this order are in proportion. Find the third proportional for (49k - k³) and (7 + k).
questions.solution:
Given:

For the value of 'k', is added to each of 13, 23, 4 and 5, the numbers obtained in this order are in proportion.

Formula used:

Third Proportional:

Let 'x' be the third proportional for a and b.

then, (a : b :: b : x)

Therefore, 

x = (b²)/(a)

Componendo and Dividendo rule for (a+b)/(a-b) 

⇒ ((a+b)+(a-b))/((a+b)-(a-b))=(a)/(b)

(a² - b²) = (a + b)(a - b)

Calculation:

According to the question,

(13 + k) : (23 + k) : : (4 + k) : (5 + k)

It can be written as:

⇒ (13 + k)/(23 + k) = (4 + k)/(5 + k)

Apply Componendo and Dividendo rule:

⇒ (13 + k + 23 + k)/(13 + k - 23 - k) = (4 + k + 5 + k)/(4 + k - 5 - k)

⇒ (36 + 2k)/(-10) = (9 + 2k)/(- 1)

⇒ 36 + 2k = 90 + 20k

⇒ 18k = -54

⇒ k = -3

Now, 

Let 'x' be the third proportional for (49k - k3) and (7 + k),

⇒ x = ((7+k)²)/((49k - k³))

⇒ x = ((7+k)²)/(k(49 - k²))

⇒ x = ((7+k)²)/(k(7 - k)(7+k))

⇒ x = ((7+k))/(k(7 - k))

Now, on substituting the value of the respective variable in the required expression, we get,

⇒ x = (7-3)/(-3(7-(-3)))

⇒ x = (-2)/(15)

∴ The third proportional for the required numbers is (-2)/(15).

questions.question: The average cost of an apple, an orange and a mango is Rs. 36. The average cost of an apple and an orange is Rs. 28 and that of an orange and a mango is Rs. 32. The cost of an orange (in Rs.) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Cost of **Orange** = (Total of first pair + Total of second pair) − Total of all three

Cost of **Orange** = (28 × 2) + (32 × 2) − (36 × 3)

Cost of **Orange** = 56 + 64 − 108

Cost of **Orange** = 120 − 108 = 12

**∴ The correct answer is ₹12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average cost of **Apple (A)**, **Orange (O)**, and **Mango (M)** = ₹36

Average cost of **Apple** and **Orange** = ₹28

Average cost of **Orange** and **Mango** = ₹32

**Formula Used:**

Total Value = Average × Number of items

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ca5087f23a68c4c8ce9eb2f5e2379103ff37c65fbadafd4af1f1918fa12837d.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total cost of (A + O + M) = 36 × 3 = 108 --- (i)

⇒ Total cost of (A + O) = 28 × 2 = 56 --- (ii)

⇒ Total cost of (O + M) = 32 × 2 = 64 --- (iii)

⇒ Adding (ii) and (iii): (A + O) + (O + M) = 56 + 64

⇒ A + 2O + M = 120

⇒ (A + O + M) + O = 120

⇒ 108 + O = 120

⇒ O = 120 − 108

⇒ O = 12

**∴ The correct answer is ₹12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Definition of Average

The **average** (Arithmetic Mean) is the sum of all observations divided by the total number of observations. Formula: Average = (Sum) ÷ (Count).

Summation from Average

To find the total value when the average is known, multiply the **average** by the number of entities: Sum = Average × n.

Weighted Average Concept

When groups of different sizes are combined, the combined average is [ (n₁ × Avg₁) + (n₂ × Avg₂) ] ÷ (n₁ + n₂).
